label: prf:hoefsmit-toroidal-ladder-locus
title: Proof of the toroidal ladder locus
html:
Proof. Expanding the ladder factor,

(d + \alpha - \beta)(d + \alpha + \beta + 1)
= d^2 + (2\alpha + 1)\, d + (\alpha - \beta)(\alpha + \beta + 1).

Equality with d^2 - 1 for all d matches coefficients: the linear coefficient gives 2\alpha + 1 = 0, so \alpha = -\tfrac{1}{2} (characteristic zero); the constant coefficient then gives

\bigl(-\tfrac{1}{2} - \beta\bigr)\bigl(\tfrac{1}{2} + \beta\bigr) = -1
\;\Longleftrightarrow\;
\bigl(\beta + \tfrac{1}{2}\bigr)^2 = 1
\;\Longleftrightarrow\;
\bigl(\beta - \tfrac{1}{2}\bigr)\bigl(\beta + \tfrac{3}{2}\bigr) = 0,

so \beta = \tfrac{1}{2} or \beta = -\tfrac{3}{2}. In a field the product vanishes only if a factor does, giving the two stated solutions, which are exchanged by the Legendre reflection \mu \mapsto -\mu - 1 about \mu = -\tfrac{1}{2}. The validity direction is the polynomial identity (d - 1)(d + 1) = d^2 - 1. \blacksquare
heading: Proof
